intro: Set up only what helps you. You can change these choices later in Settings.

flow.autosave: Your choices are saved on this device as you go.
flow.resume: You can leave and continue later.
flow.validationReminder: Enter a non-negative income amount or leave it blank.

predictableSteps.accessibility: First: choose interface preferences. Safe defaults are already selected.
predictableSteps.supportProfile: Next: optionally try a reversible starter profile, or keep your current choices.
predictableSteps.quickSetup: Then: optionally create one starter task or add monthly income.
predictableSteps.tour: Last: see where the main parts of GYLIO live.

accessibility.title: Make GYLIO comfortable to use
accessibility.subtitle: Safe defaults are already selected. Change only what helps.
accessibility.helper: Choose what feels comfortable. These are interface preferences, not medical recommendations, and you can change them later in Settings.
accessibility.textStyleHelper: Larger text and extra spacing are user-controlled reading aids. There is no single best text style for everyone.
accessibility.contrastHelper: Higher contrast improves visual separation for many people, while others prefer softer palettes. Choose what is comfortable.
accessibility.motionHelper: Following your device respects its reduced-motion setting. Reduced motion is especially useful when animation is distracting or causes discomfort.
accessibility.ttsHelper: Optional. Text-to-speech can support some readers and is safe to try; individual benefit varies.
accessibility.evidenceBody: GYLIO uses strong accessibility standards for motion, resizing and user control. Other options such as spacing or read-aloud are low-risk, reversible supports with variable individual benefit. We do not infer settings from a diagnosis.

supportProfile.title: Try a starter support profile
supportProfile.subtitle: Optional shortcuts. Keep, change, or undo them at any time.
supportProfile.helper: These profiles combine low-risk interface settings that are directionally supported by accessibility and usability research.
supportProfile.evidenceNote: This is an optional experiment, not a diagnosis-based recommendation. People with the same diagnosis can prefer very different interfaces.
supportProfile.applied: Settings applied — change them anytime by going Back now or using Settings later.

focus.label: Focus-friendly
focus.description: Larger text, reduced motion and fewer non-essential animations. A reasonable low-distraction starting point if busy interfaces pull your attention.

quiet.label: Quiet motion
quiet.description: Standard text with reduced motion and non-essential animations off. Useful to try if movement feels distracting or uncomfortable.

reading.label: Reading support
reading.description: Larger text plus optional read-aloud support. This avoids prescribing a special dyslexia font, whose average reading benefit is not reliable.

visibility.label: High visibility
visibility.description: Larger text with the high-contrast theme. Useful to try when stronger visual separation makes controls easier to find.

quickSetup.title: Start with something useful
quickSetup.subtitle: Both fields are optional. Skip them if you would rather explore first.
quickSetup.helper: A small, concrete first task can reduce setup friction. The income field is only a shortcut for creating your first Budget month.
quickSetup.goalPlaceholder: Example: Put tomorrow's documents by the door
quickSetup.goalHint: Keep it concrete and doable. Specific next actions and simple plans are directionally supported for turning intentions into action; you can edit or delete this later.
quickSetup.incomeHint: Used only to create a starting Budget month. GYLIO will not invent spending categories from this number.

tour.title: Know where things are
tour.subtitle: A short map of the app before you start.
tour.helper: You can finish immediately. Nothing on this screen is a consent or eligibility requirement.

items.tasks: Tasks — capture work and choose the next small action.
items.calendar: Calendar — place tasks and events in time.
items.budget: Budget — give income a job using your own categories.
items.rewards: Rewards — optional progress feedback you control.

tour.guideLater: The interactive Guide stays available from the header, so you do not need to memorize this now.
